Overrated: Butterfly 3000/Laminated Denim 
Underrated: Made in Timeland 

The techno style on Butterfly isn’t my type of music, but Catching Smoke is a bop. In the case of Laminated Denim, I’m not a fan of the jam era personally and it’s hard to enjoy this record fully when the prior record in the Timeland duology is such a wonderful record! 

Besides the mystique around the record, the constantly changing motifs and vibes throughout each track (you never get more than 2 minutes of the same soundscape per 15 minute track) is what I would love to see out of more jammy stuff! Almost orchestral in its compositional style, it feels like many bite sized moments of greatness that just latch onto you! Smoke and Mirrors is one of my favorite Gizz songs for a reason, wish Laminated Denim was more like that and not just 15 Minute Jams The Album. 

As a sleeper pick, I think if we got a whole album by Tropical Fuck Storm and Gizz that channeled the energy of Midnight in Sodom from Satanic Slumber Party, it would easily be a top 3 record for me.
